analysis.content: This is a screenshot of an ALERTCalifornia observation. A large column of white and grey smoke rises from mountainous terrain. Smoke spreads horizontally in a dense layer over the mountains. White and grey clouds are visible at the top. The scene is lit by daylight. At the upper left are the ALERTCalifornia logo and UC San Diego text; the upper right reads IMAGE COURTESY OF PG&E. Metadata appears at the bottom. No flames are visible.

analysis.content: This is a screenshot of an ALERTCalifornia wildfire observation. A large column of white and grey smoke rises from mountains in the centre of the image. Smoke drifts to the right and spreads over the hills. The sky is partly cloudy, with white clouds at the upper left. The upper right reads IMAGE COURTESY OF PG&E. An ALERTCalifornia logo and UC San Diego text appear at the upper left. The image appears to be an aerial or satellite view of the wildfire. No flames can be seen.

analysis.content: This is a screenshot of an ALERTCalifornia observation. It shows a night-time scene with strong white and yellow light in the centre, corresponding to an active wildfire. Intense light spreads across an irregular surface that appears mountainous or wooded. A dense cloud of smoke or vapour rises around the illuminated area and disperses into the sky. The image is black and white, making colours difficult to distinguish, but the bright centre contrasts with darker areas on either side. Flames cannot be clearly identified, but the intense light suggests a substantial heat source. Smoke is evident across the terrain.

analysis.content: This is a screenshot of an ALERTCalifornia observation, credited to UC San Diego and PG&E. It shows mountains with a large mass of smoke in the centre and on the left. Smoke rises from a darker area at the base of the mountains, suggesting a wildfire. Grey and white smoke spreads horizontally across the mountains and contrasts with the blue sky. No visible flames are present. Image quality allows mountain outlines and smoke density to be distinguished. The scene is naturally lit, probably during the day. There is no evidence of clouds or fog that could explain the observed smoke.

analysis.content: This is a screenshot from a surveillance camera. In the lower left there is an intense light source, probably the sun, illuminating the sky in orange and red. A mass of smoke or dark clouds stretches along the horizon and covers much of the sky. The scene appears to be at sunset or sunrise, with warm colours near the horizon and cooler blue tones above. Flames or fire structures cannot be clearly distinguished. Smoke is evident, but its origin cannot be determined with certainty from this image. Image quality is low and affected by distance and atmospheric conditions.
